messages:
Maya: Quick sketch attached — idea is a compact toolbar above the latency viz with: time-window presets, a bucket-size selector, and a sampling toggle. Thoughts?
Chris: I like consolidating controls. One ask: can the bucket selector default to 'auto' based on window size? avoids weird tiny buckets for 24h.
Devon: +1 to auto. Also we need clearer microcopy for sampling. Current label 'Sampling: 10%' confused PMs — they thought accuracy drops. Suggest: 'Sample rate — fraction of requests used for the chart (affects show/compare accuracy)'.
Khalid: Accessibility: the toolbar needs keyboard focus order and visible focus ring. Right now focus lands on the heatmap before the preset buttons.
Ivy: UX nit: when bucket-size is small the p95 line disappears behind the histogram bars. Can we render p95 as a dashed overlay line with a tooltip that always shows p50/p95/p99?
Maya: Good call on the overlay. Also thinking about color: heatmap currently uses red->yellow scale which fails contrast for colorblind. Propose using a colorblind-safe scale (purple -> orange) and adding a saturation knob for users.
Chris: Status update from engineering: backend can compute arbitrary buckets but we need the API param. Suggested query: `?aggregation=bucketed&buckets=20&sample_rate=0.1&window=1h` — is that expressive enough for the UI?
Devon: That works. For the UI: presets should be 15m, 1h, 6h, 24h. Add a 'live' toggle for stream mode (auto-scroll). Copy for live toggle: 'Live — auto-advance chart as new data arrives'.
Khalid: For SLO debugging, ability to pin a time-window selection and copy a link is a must. Also want a shortcut: `t` opens the timepicker (keyboard shortcut).
Ivy: Accessibility copy: tooltips must be readable by screen readers. Use aria-labels like `aria-label="Bucket size: 20"` and ensure tooltip text duplicates visible label for hover users.
Maya: Microcopy tweaks proposal (short):
- Preset button tooltip: `1 hour (default sampling: adaptive)`
- Bucket selector label: `Granularity` (help text: `fewer buckets = smoother curve; more buckets = detailed distribution`)
- Sampling toggle tooltip: `Auto (recommended) vs Manual sample rate`
Chris: Quick UI implementation note: render the toolbar as a single tabbable region with internal focusable controls. That helps screen readers and keeps focus consistent.
ConsoleBot: Reminder — design review scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. Please bring screenshots of the color scale and the overlay mock.
Devon: Action items: Maya to push new mock with overlay + colorblind palette; Chris to stub API params and add keyboard shortcut; Khalid to write accessibility checklist; Ivy to draft microcopy.
Maya: I'll upload the mock in #design and link here. Early mock shows p50 120ms / p95 780ms / p99 1.2s for the sample dataset — overlay line visible at all bucket sizes.
Chris: One last thought — show an uncertainty hint when sample_rate < 0.2 (e.g., `Estimated — low sample rate`). Small gray pill next to p95.
Ivy: Love that. Helps set expectations.
Maya: Perfect. Will iterate and post new image in the thread. :thumbsup:
